# Spectral analysis of extremes

Performs a simple spectral density estimation on the indicator series of
exceedances above a threshold.

## Usage

``` r
spectral_analysis_extremes(x, threshold)
```

## Arguments

- x:

  Numeric vector.

- threshold:

  Numeric threshold for exceedances.

## Value

List with frequency and spectral density components as returned by
\[stats::spectrum()\].

## Examples

``` r
x <- rnorm(1000)
spectral_analysis_extremes(x, threshold = 2)
```
